study: Capsule Review: original-image 512 versus 4096 Galar23 input density at fixed review workload
status: Exploratory fitting-pool experiment committed before new 4096-image source acquisition or scoring. Examination 23 was previously selected using source positive-label availability and scored by earlier CNN/heuristic audits; no independent clinical claims.

input_sampling.rule: Label-blind chronological midpoint sample from all explicitly annotated original source rows, at positions floor((2*j+1)*N/(2*m)). Use union of the two sets for physical source extraction. Do not supplement based on blood labels.

locked_image_score: Unchanged scripts/blood_image_pilot.red_excess: original PNG; EXIF transpose; RGB; ImageOps.fit centre-crop 96x96; subtract max(G,B) from R, clipped at zero; mean divided by 255. No fitting/normalization/threshold choice after outcomes.

method_definitions.uniform: At each K, select midpoint indices floor((2*j+1)*M/(2*K)) among chronologically sorted candidate M images.
method_definitions.global_red: Take K highest unchanged red_excess image scores, ties resolved by ascending original source frame ID.
method_definitions.bin_stratified_red: Divide sorted M candidates into exactly K consecutive, nonempty bins using [floor(j*M/K), floor((j+1)*M/K)); select one maximum red score in each bin, ties by ascending source frame ID. No labels enter bin construction or ranking.

endpoints.primary: For each candidate size, K and method: distinct original corrected-source blood-positive annotation runs intersected and count of explicitly blood=1 chosen images.
endpoints.secondary: Source-annotation-row distance to nearest reviewed selection (maximum, not acquisition seconds), unchanged red baseline ROC-AUC and AP on candidate images (not clinically calibrated).

integrity: Verify original corrected label ZIP SHA-256; verify source 7z index/header CRC and frozen layout/source block membership; enforce exact source HTTP 206 Range, block SHA-256, original PNG identity, image count, and no unapproved exam pixels; reproduce historical 512-source reference support and red ROC-AUC within prior publication rounding before new claims. Do not silently relax bounds or refit algorithms.
data_governance: Only aggregate counts, immutable source checksum receipts, tests and methods may enter Git. No raw medical images, per-frame identities, per-image scores or labels, weights, or private input manifests. Evaluate only already inspected fitting exam23; do not open Galar 11-20 or authors' 61-80 holdout.
negative_result_rule: Report all three methods at all four fixed workload points for both candidate sizes even if all image-score rankings fail. No model promotion or clinical claims. Avoid conflating annotation stride with elapsed acquisition time.
